releases.name: v1.0.0 - first stable release
releases.body:
## opencode-git-guard v1.0.0 - first stable release

OpenCode plugin that blocks destructive git before the bash tool runs, via `tool.execute.before`. Safe mutating commands (commit, push, checkout, rebase) pass through to OpenCode's permission layer untouched.

### Install
```json
{ "plugin": ["opencode-git-guard"] }
```

### Blocks

push --force / -f / --mirror / :refspec deletes, reset --hard, checkout -- ., checkout --orphan / -B, checkout/switch -f, branch -D/-M/--force, stash drop/clear, tag -d, reflog expire, gc --prune, update-ref, prune, filter-branch, filter-repo, forced worktree remove, clean -fd and friends. Chain-aware (&&, ;, |) - safe prefixes can't smuggle a destructive tail. Quoted messages (commit -m "git push --force") correctly pass through.

### Escape hatch

OPENCODE_GIT_GUARD_DISABLE=1

### Why 1.0.0

Block-list contract is stable from here: new patterns are minor, removals are major. Ships with CI (npm test gate), tag-driven publish with npm provenance, and one-click release bump (patch/minor/major).

*Full Changelog: https://github.com/AhmedIkram05/opencode-git-guard/compare/v0.1.2...v1.0.0*
